notes.title: New information on Crown of Greed release window
notes.notes:
Greetings, your Grace! 👑
[hr][/hr]
Today, we bring you a single, yet crucial announcement. Countless players have been asking about the date of the full release of Crown of Greed, and we believe in keeping our conversations with you clear and honest. That’s why it’s time to address the most frequently asked question across our Social Media, Discord server, and Steam discussions.


The Crown of Greed release window is set on early 2026
[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/040c65c16916b4da51a08b64bd885af45172c5c5.png

This means you'll reclaim the throne of Rodovia once again in the early months of next year. While that may seem far off, we’re confident that time will pass in the blink of an eye. We are very keen to give you the opportunity to play Crown of Greed as soon as possible, but this will not happen until we are sure that we have done everything in our power to make the title as polished, extended and fun as possible. Speaking of which...


Warm reception of the Demo and further decisions
[hr][/hr]
The Demo version was met with great enthusiasm by players worldwide. Beyond the wealth of valuable feedback we’ve received, this positive reception was an important message in itself. And so, thanks to the successful Demo version, we gained additional resources to develop the project even further than originally planned. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/dbbb4a0019eb089a5f915477d2b5aa5dccca40bb.gif

Know, that it was you - the community - who had a huge role in this important decision, and that we will continue to do whatever we can to listen to your opinions and try to implement your cool ideas into the game. Yet again, you've demonstrated your passion and unwavering support, and for that, we are truly grateful.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png


What do we plan to achieve with this extra time?
[hr][/hr]
Every extra day is worth its weight in gold here, and we gained quite a few of them! And although we are still in the planning phase, and many details are yet to be finalized, we can already share that you can look forward to:

➡️ a set of completely new systems and mechanics designed to differentiate Crown of Greed from the Majesty series while still remaining true to the core gameplay concepts. Examples? Here we go:
- the option to give names to your favorite heroes, transfer them between scenarios or even resurrect fallen champions 
- day & night system
- the new option allowing you to choose your royal banner
- the totally new decrees system, which we will tell you more about in the future. For now, we can spoil that they increase the variation between subsequent scenarios... according to your choices

➡️ at least one additional hero class and two new enemy type compared to what we planned for the original release. Once again, we don't want to spoil them yet, as they need an appropriate presentation, but these are the classes you asked for most often in your suggestions

➡️ extensive campaign system
- numerous, varied scenarios, each with its own setting, variables and victory conditions
- additional "tower defense" scenarios focusing on defending the base, which is attacked by increasingly larger waves of enemies
- a new system that will allow you to spend earned points between scenarios to unlock new buildings, technologies, heroes skills and so on; now you will be able to shape your own unique playstyle!

➡️ lots of balance changes, better AI of player units and enemies, tons of general improvements and fixes, a number of other minor changes or additions

➡️ numerous Quality of Life changes

➡️ animation improvements

➡️ sounds and audio improvements


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/6e44ec63d335e7e57bd697963c25e742ed7aa1f0.gif

More info coming soon!
[hr][/hr]
As time goes by, we will certainly be able to share more details and specific information. We'd love to tell you all about them in the future, so be sure to stay tuned! We trust that the additional production time for Crown of Greed will greatly enhance its quality, and we hope this decision will be met with your support.

Thank you, your Grace!

notes.title: Demo Hotfix 0.1.7 is live
notes.notes:
Good news, your Grace! 👑
[hr][/hr]
The first Crown of Greed Demo Hotfix was released just two days ago... and we are not slowing down! We are pleased to announce that thanks to the commitment of our team and your wonderful, helpful feedback, we have managed to prepare a completely new update - namely Hotfix 0.1.7.

This time, our main goal was to get rid of the bugs and issues that you reported to us via Steam and Discord server. As you can see from the list below, we did quite well! However, bugfixing is not the only change we have prepared. It's time to take a look at the... 👇 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/5b815e135a6f35dead13099bf99882672c2bef98.png

Crown of Greed Demo - Hotfix 0.1.7 Notes:
[hr][/hr]
• Increased melee range for all units
• Implemented new music tracks
• The colors of buildings on the minimap are now more visible
• Improved the heroes' escape system mechanics
• Treasure stacking now has a greater range
• Improved the rotation of the Arena building
• Improved heroes AI for collecting treasures
• Fixed a bug that caused insufficient rewards when the reward was still high
• Fixed combat sounds that were not playing properly
• Fixed a glitch that allowed infinite gold generation
• Fixed the functionality of the Tactician trait
• Fixed a bug where characters would get stuck on treasures
• Fixed a bug preventing heroes from visiting the Arena
• Fixed a bug preventing workers from repairing buildings
• Fixed gray portraits for quests and heroes
• Fixed a bug causing unwanted behavior from destroyed buildings
• Fixed hero movement at the Rally Point
• Fixed defense quest AI—heroes no longer travel between quests of the same type
• Fixed a bug where the Guardian could not reach a destroyed tower
• The Action Panel is no longer disabled when opening castle, flag, or cemetery panels
• Changed keybinds for some panels
• Updated the GuideBook with current keybinds
• Adjusted main menu background scaling and banner placement on widescreen resolutions


We hope that the new Hotfix will make your experience even more immersive and fun. As always, we await your opinions, suggestions and cool ideas on our Social Media channels, Discord server and Steam Discussions 📣 Thank you!


Good luck in Rodovia, Rulers

notes.title: The first Demo Hotfix is here!
notes.notes:
Hope you enjoy your Demo adventure, your Grace! 👑
[hr][/hr]
Our team has spent the last several dozen hours thoroughly analyzing your reports, feedback and comments, and based on them, we have managed to prepare the very first Demo Hotfix. 

We have received a lot of important information through our Social Media channels, Steam and Discord server, thanks to which we better understand your expectations and the gameplay elements that, in your opinion, require our attention and corrections 🤓 Thank you for your help, Kings! 

We are aware that today's Hotfix does not address all issues and bugs, and you can expect more to come in the near future. But for now... let's dive into the first one, shall we? 👇



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/282ee0b457fa38b4b1640be36fbbdad3954a9d8b.png

Crown of Greed Demo - Hotfix 0.1.6 Notes:
[hr][/hr]
• New loading-screen design and faster loading time of the game
• Camera operation improvements
• Tooltips are now larger and easier to read
• The Trading Post building is now rotated and thus more visible
• Arena requirements for Heroes are now visible after selecting the building
• Reduced the number of Heroes getting stuck when searching for treasures to collect
• Heroes get more max HP per level
• Character models are now bigger
• Heroes now accept new contracts faster
• A completed scouting contract now reveals more terrain
• Fixed a bug that allowed structures to be built outside the appropriate area while the game was paused
• Fixed a bug that blocked casting spells during active pause
• Fixed a bug related with the rally point for the coordinated attack flag
• Fixes to the NPCs movement, now some characters move faster


Good luck in Rodovia, Rulers!

notes.title: Playtest Patch 0.1.4 🛠️ and upcoming Demo
notes.notes:
Greetings, your Grace! 👑
[hr][/hr]
All good things come to an end someday, and this also applies to our Playtest. On Monday morning, the gates of Rodovia will close as we shift our focus to analyzing key insights that will guide the future development of Crown of Greed.

But don't worry - we have two exciting updates to brighten the mood! 🤩

1. Based on your feedback, we have just published the last, fourth Patch for the game

2. We are happy to announce that... you will soon have another opportunity to play the game, this time in the Demo version!

We’ll share all the details about the Demo version in a dedicated announcement, but for now, we just want you to know what's coming next 📣 Stay tuned for more updates!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/3278502f35bc179edeead01ed0cbd48fd1b86079.png

Playtest Patch 0.1.4 Notes:
[hr][/hr]
Bug Fixes:
• Fixed a bug that caused respawned workers to be blocked after being killed while working
• Fixed a bug that caused a huge number of enemies hidden in the fog of war to block workers
• Fixes to the Scouting order contract, fixes to the operation of order contracts 
• Fixed translation issues occurring after changing the language of the game
• The option to open the ended contract panel has been disabled


Improvements:
• Added a new traits tooltip to the character panel 
• Added new tooltips to order flags
• Improvements to the interaction of newly constructed buildings and environmental elements


Balance:
•  Increase the berserker's fight-engage range



Please note 📜
[hr][/hr]
Keep in mind that this is only a "work-in-progress" version of the game, the main goal of which is to present the overall concept of this project and its novelties. Remember, that at this stage you may encounter some bugs and problems, as the title is still in development. Crown of Greed is sure to receive numerous patches, most of them based on your feedback.



A word from the team 💭
[hr][/hr]
Please know that your feedback is very important to our entire team and that we remain at your disposal on our Discord server, Social Media channels and Steam Discussions. The fastest and most convenient way to provide us with your opinion is to use this dedicated Feedback Form. Thank you, kings!

notes.title: Playtest Patch 0.1.3 🛠️
notes.notes:
Greetings, your Grace! 👑
[hr][/hr]
Two Patches for the Playtest version are already behind us, but we are not slowing down! Today we have prepared another, third Patch, which continues our mission to polish and improve the Crown of Greed project.

New players from all over the world are constantly joining our Playtest, and their feedback allows us to plan our next steps 📜 And so, without further ado, let's check what changes await us in the latest update.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/ba8cf209a41fc427f540c9efab20467e93a229a0.png

Playtest Patch 0.1.3 Notes:
[hr][/hr]
Bug Fixes:
• Fixed a bug that caused monsters to hide in their habitats too soon after combat
• Fixed contract panel closing when any non-targeted contract was completed
• Fixed a bug that caused a player to be unable to open the habitat panel when his contract panel was open
• Fixes to the Marketplace and the Heroes' equipment. Now, heroes can't own more than 1 stack of a single item
• Toggling technology tooltips in the Building Panel has been fixed, and they now display the required gold status properly
• Fixes to other technology related tooltips


Improvements:
• Additional events for high difficulty levels 
• In the Blacksmith panel, all technologies are now visible (but blocked if the player does not meet the requirements)
• Treasure chest models are now bigger


Balance:
• Adjustments to gold generation in buildings (reduced in all buildings, increased in Trading Posts) 
• Undead Warrior, Crossbowman and Captain are now stronger
• Rogue agility stat is now nerfed (lower chance to dodge)
• Heroes now stay in combat longer and start running away after losing more health points than before



Please note 📜
[hr][/hr]
Keep in mind that this is only a "work-in-progress" version of the game, the main goal of which is to present the overall concept of this project and its novelties. notes.title: Playtest Patch 0.1.2 🛠️
notes.notes:
Greetings, your Grace! 👑
[hr][/hr]
Another day, another Patch to the game! Our entire team is doing its best to respond to your reports as quickly as possible and implement appropriate fixes to the Crown of Greed Playtest. We still receive a huge amount of feedback, which helps us a lot in our task to polish the game, so keep it coming, ok?

Today we managed to get rid of several bugging bugs (pun intended) and introduce many improvements, including a new, very important option - difficulty levels. Let's take a look 👀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/25b736866ee96f1383cf6cc88fce5a221670b451.png

Playtest Patch 0.1.2 Notes:
[hr][/hr]
Bug Fixes:
• Fixed a bug that caused heroes belonging to a group to get stuck in a city
• Fixed a bug that caused heroes to get stuck in the Market
• Fixed a bug that caused the entire map to be cleared from the fog of war
• Fixed an issue that caused heroes not to perform the scouting missions
• Fixed an issue that caused the notification list to block or stutter
• Fixes to the re-built buildings' prices 
• Bear material fix


Improvements:
• Adjustments to the tier 3 towers prices
• Adjustments to enemies' habitats health points
• Developed technologies disappear from the forge panel
• Added a new button that allows to return to the previous panel in the castle panel
• Heroes can't own more than 1 stack of a single item (e.g., a maximum of 8 potions) 
• The task panel is now more clear
• Buttons in the upper right corner of the screen are easier to read


Balance:
• Added an option that allows players to change the difficulty of the game
• Health Potion now has a shorter cooldown
• Spells range increased
• Spells power increased
• Reduced threat levels to enemies and their habitats
• Guards are now more durable (increased HP)
• Some character models have been enlarged
• Monster attack waves are now slightly weaker, but some monsters deal additional damage
• Increased cooldown between attacks of some monsters
• Heroes now need less time to learn new skills


Please note 📜
[hr][/hr]
Keep in mind that this is only a "work-in-progress" version of the game, the main goal of which is to present the overall concept of this project and its novelties. Remember, that at this stage you may encounter some bugs and problems, as the title is still in development. Crown of Greed is sure to receive numerous patches, most of them based on your feedback.

notes.notes:
Greetings, your Grace! 👑
[hr][/hr]
Thanks to your awesome feedback, we managed to prepare the very first Patch to the game. Your reports are coming to us in a wide stream on our Discord server, Steam discussions and Social Media, for which we are very grateful. You have proven once again that we can count on your support and enthusiasm. 🤩 Well done! 

And so, based on your feedback, we are introducing a number of improvements and fixes to the Crown of Greed Playtest version.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/b8ada22dfe84788bbaf8e4a4e2425be14f185cd6.png

Playtest Patch 0.1.1 Notes:
[hr][/hr]
Bug Fixes:
• Fixed an issue with tax collectors and workers disappearing
• Fixed an issue with heroes not being assigned to missions for more challenging habitats
• Fixed an issue causing overlapping of different panels on the right side of the screen
• Fixed a bug with missing graphics for certain items
• Fixed a bug with icons in hero headquarters not disappearing after being recruited
• Fixed a bug with caravans traveling to the most recently built marketplace instead of the nearest one
• Fixed a bug with characters visible in the fog of war

• The minimap is now bigger
• Missing descriptions have been added
• Changes to the content of tooltips
• Adjustment to the minimum FPS setting in the game options
• Added the option to change anti-aliasing settings in the game
• Lower-level heroes will now have different skins
• Some visual effects have been enlarged for better readability
• Updates to the Guidebook
• The Alt key now displays additional information about buildings
• Increased width of the mission panel and hero list

Balance:
• Tower prices have been increased
• The number of enemies generated on the map has been increased
• The number of monster habitats has been increased
• Some enemies now deal more damage 


Please note 📜
[hr][/hr]
Keep in mind that this is only a "work-in-progress" version of the game, the main goal of which is to present the overall concept of this project and its novelties.
